digest.component_or_area: git call site timeout bounding across network-capable operations
propositions: Network-capable git call sites in gerrit_client and workspace modules lack timeout bounds, allowing indefinite hangs on stuck remotes or hung credential helpers
subprocess.TimeoutExpired propagates unhandled from gerrit_client.clone_change_ref, exposing user:token@host credentials in the exception message before redaction can occur
workspace._git helper calls subprocess.run without timeout, making every git invocation in that module unbounded including two network-capable fetches
Cold clone operations (git init + fetch into fresh directory) legitimately require 300s timeout bound, matching bug 747f precedent rather than the 30s _store precedent
_ref_lock.py is already fully bounded by structural design (timeout as required keyword-only parameter) and requires no modification
